clips.title: The story
paras: Feathers for Binding is a quest in Shadowgale Forest centered on gathering insulating plumage from young shrieklings to craft a protective medicinal poultice. While these normally docile creatures have grown dangerously aggressive, their feathers remain essential for preserving antiseptic salves against the elements. Adventurers must brave the hostile fledglings to secure the materials needed for regional care.

In the depths of Shadowgale Forest, preparing field medicine often demands resourcefulness from the land. When treating grave injuries, herbalists and healers turn to a specialized poultice built on moss and antiseptic tree sap. To ensure the sap does not rapidly dry out or lose its potency to harsh weather, durable insulative bindings are required. The juvenile feathers of Shadowgale shrieklings provide an ideal natural barrier, shielding the wound while sealing in the medicinal treatment.

Procuring these downy feathers has become unexpectedly perilous. Under ordinary circumstances, young Shadowgale shrieklings are docile woodland dwellers. In recent times, however, an inexplicable spike in aggression has swept through their ranks. Wielding formidable talons capable of inflicting lethal wounds, these young predators now strike aggressively at passersby. Harvesting their plumage requires adventurers to face a creature transformed from a harmless fledgling into a genuine hazard.

Asking travelers to hunt juvenile creatures weighs heavily on the local caretakers, who openly mourn the necessity of the cull. Yet with multiple emergencies threatening the region and the beasts growing increasingly dangerous, thinning their numbers serves a dual purpose: gathering vital curative materials while suppressing a burgeoning threat to the forest's paths. Every feather gathered is treated with respect, ensuring their sacrifice is not wasted.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.
Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.
